evidence.detail: rs/l/d/c, already reviewed as LoginScreen, constructs rs/l/d/d directly inside LoginScreen.run() and installs it on the launcher JFrame with addMouseListener.
rs/l/d/d extends java.awt.event.MouseAdapter and its only overridden action is mousePressed; outside the exact hitbox gate it returns without side effects.
The handler accepts clicks only while the Client login screen is active and the mouse lies in the fixed latest-update region x=10..132, y=460..485.
The accepted click invokes Client.f with the exact URL https://spawnpk.net/forums/index.php?/forum/10-updates/, the same SpawnPK updates forum consumed by R155 LoginUpdateFetcher.

R155 independently proves rs/l/d/e is LoginUpdateFetcher owned by the same LoginScreen and same updates-forum URL, so rs/l/d/d is the input-side link handler for that exact login update presentation rather than a generic browser launcher.

proposals.note: LoginUpdateLinkMouseHandler is fixed by direct LoginScreen construction, JFrame MouseListener registration, the exact latest-update hitbox and the same SpawnPK updates-forum URL used by LoginUpdateFetcher. Confidence is 0.999.
